body.name: I_j^{\alpha}
body.construction: For \(j\in\mathcal J\), \(I_j^{\alpha}=[\inf_{p'\in\mathcal C_{n,\alpha}(\widehat p)}\inf\{q_j(\mathcal M):(G,\mathcal M)\in\mathfrak F(\mathcal S,L,H,p')\},\ \sup_{p'\in\mathcal C_{n,\alpha}(\widehat p)}\sup\{q_j(\mathcal M):(G,\mathcal M)\in\mathfrak F(\mathcal S,L,H,p')\}]\).
